decisions: Named same-instance Rhythm users only; no public or bearer links in v1.
Default expiration is 30 days; owner revocation is immediate.
File contents, tool outputs, emails, PCO data, secret matches, system prompts, and attachments are excluded by default; protected categories require explicit per-item inclusion.
Secret-shaped values, authorization fields, and host paths are redacted even inside explicitly included items.
Share/view/revoke/delete audit records contain actor and timestamp but no transcript content and are visible to the owner.
Owners and admins may revoke; stored snapshots are immutable and source ids are provenance rather than read dependencies via foreign keys.
